'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Aaron Groth DS Endor''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Groth]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Aqui, Aqui
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
